question: Which of the five has been most explicit about serving mass-affluent clients, and what exactly have they said?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James defines its Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program as providing training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients, 'generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets,' as reported by the firm.
items.quote: the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets
items.definition: high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: Raymond James states its wealth strategies 'bring the best of our firm to your high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.'
items.quote: Wealth Strategies: Bring the best of our firm to your high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients

items.text: Raymond James' CEO says the firm's private wealth advisor program and expanded alternatives investment platform 'supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.'
items.quote: our private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients

items.text: Raymond James CEO states the firm 'has been really growing assets by bringing on higher quality teams, that are focused on, higher net worth clients.'
items.quote: we've been really growing assets by bringing on higher quality teams, that are focused on, higher net worth clients

items.text: Raymond James states its Private Wealth Guided Portfolios are 'for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.'
items.quote: Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, which integrate traditional and alternative investments within risk-based portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients

items.text: Raymond James' PCG president says the firm is 'committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve,' referring to 'individuals and families with significant wealth.'
items.quote: we're committed to being a destination for private wealth advisors and the clients they serve. Individuals and families with significant wealth require truly personal advice

items.text: Raymond James describes its Structured lending as 'offered to High Net Worth / Ultra-High Net Worth Private Client Group clients.'
items.quote: Structured lending offered to High Net Worth / Ultra-High Net Worth Private Client Group clients

items.text: Raymond James' CEO says the firm has 'high-net-worth focused advisors' with access to private investments, including 'private investments for clients with $50 million and above of investable assets.'
items.quote: We have a lot of high-net-worth focused advisors with clients that are interested in the products... private investments for clients with $50 million and above of investable assets
items.definition: private investments for clients with $50 million and above of investable assets

items.text: Raymond James' 10-K states its regulated UK subsidiaries' retail sector provides services 'to predominantly high-net-worth individuals.'
items.quote: Certain of these subsidiaries operate in the retail sector, providing investment and financial planning services to predominantly high-net-worth individuals

items.text: Raymond James' CEO describes focusing on 'increasingly high-net-worth clients' for private market products.
items.quote: They're really investing in the education and increasing the awareness of the solutions to the advisors and the increasingly high-net-worth clients

cells.reason: Multiple passages show Raymond James explicitly names high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth segments, but none uses the specific term 'mass-affluent.'
